Maya Rivera: quick heads-up — noticed a few dark-mode regressions on Console logs + Metrics after yesterday's deploy.
Luca Chen: ugh, thanks for flagging. which pages specifically?
Maya Rivera: logs and latency heatmap overview. screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/console-logs-dark.png. inline code tokens like `user_id` and `req_id` look washed out; heatmap series blend together when printed in grayscale.
Ava Gomez: can you paste current CSS vars? I can prototype fixes.
Maya Rivera: current: `--code-bg: #1f2a33`, `--code-fg: #9aa6b2`. Chart series A=#7fa3ff, B=#b28cff, C=#a0c48a. On zoom the code fg fails AA contrast against the bg.
Luca Chen: yep that's low. target is WCAG AA (4.5:1) for inline text; small code chips should meet that too. quick calc: #9aa6b2 on #1f2a33 ≈ 3.2:1.
Samir Patel: options: lighten the fg to ~#cfe6ff, or add a subtle 1px border to chips (`rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`) so bg remains dark but tokens pop.
Ava Gomez: I prefer keeping token bg dark. propose `--code-fg: #c8e6ff` + `--code-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`. keeps text readable without changing overall tone.
Maya Rivera: that should help. also heatmap: A/B/C are problematic for deuteranopia tests — overlap confuses the slope.
Luca Chen: let's pick a colorblind-safe palette: blue #4aa3ff, orange #ff9f5a, teal #2ab9a3. provide desaturated hover states.
Ava Gomez: will generate previews. two more visual nits: axis gridlines at 8% white on dark disappear in exported PNGs — suggest bump to 12% or use a 1px dashed at slightly darker value.
Samir Patel: agree. and the tokenizer streaming dot is neon green rn; clashes with modal overlays. propose `--stream-accent: #39d3b8` (teal) per motion guidelines.
Maya Rivera: teal looks better against blue/orange palette.
DesignBot: accessibility-audit: logs page v2.3.4 — issues found: inline-code contrast fail (WCAG 2.1 AA), chart series similarity (fail for deuteranopia). Recommendations: increase contrast to >=4.5:1, adopt WCAG-friendly palette, ensure min 1px stroke for axes in dark mode.
Ava Gomez: I'll open a small PR with token color, border, chart palette update, axis opacity change, and streaming accent swap. will include before/after images + a11y ratios. ETA: EOD PST.
Luca Chen: can we add a user setting toggle "High-contrast charts"? default = accessible, toggle = vivid saturated hues for customers who want punchier visuals.
Samir Patel: +1. default must remain accessible. toggle sounds fine.
Maya Rivera: nice — if PR lands tomorrow we can ship in next minor. please tag @design for sign-off.
Ava Gomez: will do, pinging here once PR is up.
Maya Rivera: thanks team :raised_hands:
